timeline
    title 글램스테르담 일정
    2025-12-03 : Fulu 메인넷
    2026 상반기 : 최초 메인넷 목표
    2026-05-11 : 실행 계층 EIP 8개 확정
    2026-08-03 : 최초 Sepolia 목표 (연기)
    2026-08 중순 : 메인넷 목표 4분기로 이동
    2026-09-03 : ACDC 186, Sepolia 10월 6일 결정
    2026-09-14 : Devnet-11
    2026-10-06 : Sepolia 활성화 (블록 11856337)
    미정 : Hoodi, 메인넷

sequenceDiagram participant B as 빌더 participant P as 제안자 participant V as 검증자 (위원회) participant T as PTC B->>P: 입찰 (SignedExecutionPayloadBid) P->>V: 비콘 블록 (입찰 약속만 포함) Note over V: 슬롯의 25% 지점까지 증명
(ATTESTATION_DUE_BPS_GLOAS 2500) B->>T: 실행 페이로드 공개 Note over B: 슬롯의 50% 지점 (PAYLOAD_DUE_BPS 5000) T->>V: 페이로드 적시성 증명 Note over T: 슬롯의 75% 지점
(PAYLOAD_ATTESTATION_DUE_BPS 7500)

timeline
    title Glamsterdam schedule
    2025-12-03 : Fulu on mainnet
    H1 2026 : first mainnet target
    2026-05-11 : eight EL EIPs scheduled
    2026-08-03 : first Sepolia target (slipped)
    mid-Aug 2026 : mainnet target moves to Q4
    2026-09-03 : ACDC 186 sets Sepolia for Oct 6
    2026-09-14 : Devnet-11
    2026-10-06 : Sepolia live (block 11856337)
    unscheduled : Hoodi, mainnet

sequenceDiagram participant B as Builder participant P as Proposer participant V as Attesters participant T as PTC B->>P: bid (SignedExecutionPayloadBid) P->>V: beacon block (bid commitment only) Note over V: attest by 25% of the slot
(ATTESTATION_DUE_BPS_GLOAS 2500) B->>T: reveal execution payload Note over B: by 50% of the slot (PAYLOAD_DUE_BPS 5000) T->>V: payload timeliness attestation Note over T: by 75% of the slot
(PAYLOAD_ATTESTATION_DUE_BPS 7500)
